_note: Per-direction slot options. The dealer picks one governing asset, one display treatment and the hero moments from these lists, so two builds of the same direction still differ. Every option is drawn from the visible signatures in the 114-app corpus (research/reports/Mobile app visual corpus pass.md). Identity comes from the governing asset, never from the body typeface.

shell: quiet: neutral chrome, status colour is the only hue
governing_asset: one hero readout line (a bold value with a smaller same-baseline unit) that repeats on the widget and the Live Activity
a labelled data curve with a scrub marker
a semantic map: one entity per sheet, status carried by pin colour
a gauge with an honest per-metric scale and a target tick
display_treatment: bold values with smaller same-baseline unit suffixes
small all-caps tracked state labels set above each value
monospaced readouts for every changing number
hero_moment: the tracked entity changes state (the label and its semantic colour update together)
scrubbing the curve with a selection tick per data point
the readout hands off to a glance surface (Live Activity or widget)

shell: loud on the identity surface only: team colour floods the game surface, chrome stays minimal
governing_asset: a team-colour surface: a two-team gradient behind each game
italic team-code watermarks behind the score
a field graphic that shows where play is
display_treatment: heavy width-condensed score numerals at 30-40 pt
condensed italic score numerals with timeout dots beneath
hero_moment: a score change: the numeral rolls and the play sentence updates
the game goes final: the surface settles from live to result
pinning a game to the top of the board

shell: loud: the object and its controls are the interface, system chrome nearly absent
governing_asset: a rendered 3D object that is the readout (its state maps to data)
a small diorama built from the user's own content
a physical control deck: a knurled dial and chunky keys
display_treatment: blocky heavy titles
condensed numerals with monospaced all-caps labels
a segment-display timer
hero_moment: turning or pressing the object, with an impact matched to its visual mass
the object changes state when the data changes
picking a colourway

shell: quiet: achromatic chrome with one reserved accent
governing_asset: a three-step ladder of dark surfaces separated by lightness, with borders instead of shadows
one reserved accent that appears on a single gesture or action and nowhere else
a command surface reachable from every screen
display_treatment: a neutral grotesque with grey sentence-case labels
monospaced numerals for metadata
hero_moment: the one accented action (for example, swipe to complete)
the command surface opening over the current screen
a row changing status in place

shell: loud shell, quiet lists: the owned colour floods one surface and stays out of lists, status and confirm steps
governing_asset: one owned colour that floods exactly one surface while lists stay ink on white
an authored object system: rendered coins, cards or object avatars
a physical card render that the app returns to
display_treatment: a custom display face on the hero amount or title only
split-size numerals (large units, small fractions)
extended caps for section titles
hero_moment: the commit moment on the flooded surface
the card render turning to show its other side
the success state after a committed result

shell: loud: thick-lipped controls and a character on most screens
governing_asset: one flat-vector character cast that acts out state
slab buttons with a thick darker bottom lip on everything tappable
speech-bubble guidance in the character's voice
display_treatment: a heavy rounded display face over a rounded body face
hero_moment: a task completes and the character reacts
the progress path advances one step
a milestone in the product's own form (not a flame and a number)

shell: quiet chrome, loud content: the user sets the colour, the app does not
governing_asset: the user's cover image sets the page (a blurred cover gradient or a sampled tint)
a user-chosen theme used as the page background
display_treatment: a wide grotesque with lowercase titles
system bold only (the quiet register)
hero_moment: picking a cover re-tints the whole page
committing an RSVP
sharing the finished page

shell: owned: illustration and palette carry the brand, controls stay plain
governing_asset: one illustration hand on every content surface
a fixed palette of three hues used flat, with no pure black text
a pastel flood per screen with text tinted to match
display_treatment: a face matched to the hand (handwritten, slab-like serif or rounded)
plain system type that stays out of the illustration's way
hero_moment: the illustration responds when an entry is completed
the day's entry is revealed
a collection fills in

shell: quiet: the state headline is the loudest thing on screen
governing_asset: a plain-language state headline as the hero of home
one non-colour state carrier (a pose, a glyph or a shape that tracks state)
a closed colour-meaning set: each hue means one state and nothing else
display_treatment: rounded numerals
a serif headline over a light grotesque
hero_moment: today's state is revealed
a check-in is logged
a trend is explained in a sentence

shell: quiet chrome, loud artifact: display type and colour live only inside the artifact
governing_asset: the shareable artifact (a poster, sticker or card) with its own type and colour
masks and die-cut shapes on the artifact while chrome keeps ordinary radii
display_treatment: display type that appears only inside the artifact
hero_moment: the artifact is generated from the user's data
switching the artifact's style
export and share

shell: quiet: the sky is the only surface, controls float over it
governing_asset: a sky whose hue comes from the real light phase
an object on a dotted path
a scrubbable time axis
display_treatment: a centred semibold countdown
white pill time labels
hero_moment: scrubbing through time with a tick at each phase boundary
a phase change recolours the sky
snapping back to now

shell: quiet: achromatic chrome around user photos
governing_asset: the constraint state as a drawn component (a lock, a blur, a date stamp or a countdown)
achromatic chrome, so the user's photos are the only hue
display_treatment: none dealt: this direction shares behaviour, not type
hero_moment: the unlock or reveal
capturing inside the window
the period turning over

shell: owned: block hues carry the page, chrome stays near-white
governing_asset: a vertical time axis where capsule length equals duration
a hue per block as the reading layer, with a glyph as the non-colour cue
a now-line that crosses the day
display_treatment: a heavy date header
hero_moment: dragging a block to reschedule, with a tick at each snap
completing a block
the now-line crossing into a block

shell: quiet: near-black stage, artwork is the only colour
governing_asset: artwork as the only multi-hue element on a near-black stage
surfaces tinted from the current artwork
one accent that appears only on play or selection
display_treatment: black-weight hero titles
a semibold title over a light secondary line
hero_moment: play
artwork expanding into its detail page
logging or rating an item

shell: quiet: chrome recedes until asked for
governing_asset: the page itself as the interface, with 28-30 pt margins
one theme accent for links and the cursor
floating capsules as the only chrome
display_treatment: a reading face at about 1.6 line height
a face the user chooses per document
hero_moment: chrome receding when writing starts
switching theme
switching between documents or slots

shell: quiet: paper, type and one muted accent
governing_asset: a serif reading face on warm paper with a muted accent that is not orange
a non-cream warm ground (warm grey or warm white) with serif replies
a status visual that encodes state (listening, thinking, speaking)
display_treatment: replies in serif with the user's text in sans
regular-weight serif titles at 28-32 pt
hero_moment: a reply arriving
the voice visual changing with state
thinking shown as readable status lines
